tool: Supabase — production DB (read by the dashboard)
reads: events, profiles and orders: the tables the numbers on / come from. Steve does not log into Supabase: he reads the live numbers in this dashboard, which queries them with the growth_ro role.
role: No Supabase user for Steve. Postgres role growth_ro: SELECT only on the 10 tables it reads, read-only transactions enforced, at most 5 connections. Never the SQL editor, never a service key, never a member of the Supabase project.
steps: Andrea approves the #GROWTH-LIVE PROPOSAL (dashboard README) with APPROVE.
Calde creates the growth_ro role with the SQL in the PROPOSAL; the password (32+ characters) never goes through chat, tickets or commits.
Calde sets GROWTH_DATA_SOURCE=live and GROWTH_DATABASE_URL (Sensitive) only on the betredge-growth Vercel project, never on the product, and redeploys.
Steve opens the dashboard: instead of the «Snapshot … not live» banner it shows «Read at».
verify: «New profiles» over 7 days on the page = the «New profiles | 7d» row of npm run verify run by Calde with the growth_ro role; a test write with the role is rejected (SQLSTATE 25006).

reads: Visitors, page views and referrers of the product site (betredge team, betredge project): an independent check of events (G10). The script loads only with cookie consent, like the dashboard sessions: it does not measure traffic without consent (G13). Speed Insights is not installed in the product (@vercel/speed-insights is missing): until it is enabled there is nothing to read.
role: Member of the betredge team with the Viewer role: read only, no deploys, no environment variables. Whether the role exists on the team's plan is to be checked in the interface. If it does not, do not fall back to Member (it deploys and reads the env vars): a weekly export by the owner is better.
steps: vercel.com → betredge team → Settings → Members.
Invite Member → Steve's personal email → Viewer role → Invite.
If the team allows per-project access (option to be checked in the interface), limit it to the betredge project.
Steve accepts the invite with his own Vercel account.
verify: betredge project → Analytics → last 7 days → Page Views: of the same order as the page_views WITH a session in the dashboard over 7 days (page views minus those without session_id), because both count only with consent. Much higher, or zero, must be reported to Calde.

reads: Clicks, impressions, CTR and average position by query and by page. It is the source of organic traffic (G05) and does not depend on cookie consent (G13).
role: User with «Restricted» permission: sees the reports, does not change settings or users.
steps: search.google.com/search-console → the www.betredge.com property (the one where Andrea is listed as owner).
Settings → Users and permissions → Add user.
Steve's personal Google email → «Restricted» permission → Add.
owner: Andrea (owner of the property: to be confirmed in the interface)
verify: Performance → Search results → last 28 days → «Total clicks»: Steve reads the same number Andrea sees on the same screen.

reads: Subscriptions, amounts, renewals and cancellations. Stripe amounts do not reach the DB (G03): today they can only be read here.
role: Read-only role: «Analyst» if exporting is needed, «View only» if looking is enough. No role that allows refunds, changes or API keys. Exact role names and permissions: to be checked in the interface (role descriptions on the Team page).
steps: dashboard.stripe.com → Settings → Team and security → Team.
Add member → Steve's personal email → Analyst role (or View only) → Send invite.
Steve turns on two-factor authentication at first login.
verify: Billing → Subscriptions, Active status: the number must equal the profiles with plan_source stripe and not expired (0 in the DB today). If Stripe shows more, the DB does not see them: report it to Calde.

reads: Payments, refunds and disputes of the PayPal orders, to reconcile the «External revenue Paygate + PayPal» tile.
role: Personal secondary user with only the permissions to view and download reports and transactions: no sending money, no refunds, no profile changes. Exact name of the permissions: to be checked in the interface.
steps: paypal.com, business account → Account settings → user management (path to be checked in the interface).
Add user → Steve's name and email.
Tick only the read permissions on reports and activity; leave payments, refunds, withdrawals and settings off.
Steve chooses his own password at first login: the user is his, the main login is not shared.
verify: Activity → completed payments in the last 30 days = PayPal orders with paid_at in the last 30 days (Calde reads them from paypal_orders).

reads: Orders and takings of the PayGate checkout. They are already in the DB (paygate_orders, in the «External revenue» tile): the access is needed only to reconcile.
role: Personal user with the lowest role available, without withdrawals or settings. We do not know whether PayGate supports secondary users: to be checked in the interface. If it does not, no access: the account login is not shared.
steps: Andrea checks in the PayGate panel whether there is user or role management (to be checked in the interface).
If there is: a personal invite to Steve with the lowest role, without withdrawals or settings.
If there is not: Steve reads PayGate from the dashboard (paygate_orders) and Calde reports the panel total on request.
verify: Paid orders in the last 30 days in the PayGate panel = paygate_orders orders with paid_at in the last 30 days (Calde).

reads: Orders, refunds and amounts in the store currency. The DB stores the amount but not the currency (G03).
role: Personal staff account with only the Analytics and Reports permissions, plus reading Orders if the single order needs to be seen. No Settings, Products, Payments, Apps or refunds. Exact permission names: to be checked in the interface. Each staff account takes a seat on the plan.
steps: Shopify admin → Settings → Users and permissions.
Add staff → Steve's name and email.
Tick only Analytics and Reports (and Orders, checking that it does not allow refunds) → Send invite.
verify: Orders filtered by «Paid», all time = «Paid Shopify orders — all time» in the dashboard (Oct 6 snapshot: 1).

steps: Whoever holds the affiliate account opens the GG.BET portal → users or sub-accounts section (to be checked in the interface).
Create a reporting sub-user for Steve's email.
If the portal does not support it: ask the affiliate manager (the contact goes through Fredrik) for a read-only user or a weekly CSV.
owner: Andrea (holder of the affiliate account: to be confirmed)
verify: Portal clicks in the last 30 days vs «Clicks by partner → GG.BET» in the dashboard over 30 days (Oct 6 snapshot: 1). They must be of the same order.

reads: Sends, deliveries, opens, clicks, bounces and complaints of the CRM lifecycle emails.
role: Team member with the lowest role available, never Admin. What that role can do is to be checked in the interface: if it can create API keys or send emails, do not grant it and fall back to a periodic export.
steps: resend.com → team settings → members (path to be checked in the interface).
Invite → Steve's email → lowest role available.
Steve accepts the invite with his own account.
verify: Emails → last 7 days → number of sends: of the same order as the sends of the CRM cron that Calde reads for the same period.

reads: Reach, impressions, followers, interactions and link clicks of @betr.edge (and of the Facebook page, if linked).
role: Person in the business portfolio with partial access: only the Instagram/Page assets and only the permission to view Insights (analyst). Never «full control» nor admin of the portfolio. Exact permission names: to be checked in the interface.
steps: business.facebook.com → Settings → Users → People → Add.
Steve's email → employee access, not admin access.
Assign assets: Instagram account @betr.edge (and the Page) → only the Insights permission (to be checked in the interface).
Steve accepts the invite from his own account.
owner: Andrea (holder of the business portfolio: to be confirmed)
verify: @betr.edge Insights → last 28 days → «Accounts reached»: Steve reads the same number the holder sees on the same screen.

reads: Views, followers, interactions and profile visits of the BetRedge TikTok account.
role: If the account is linked to a TikTok Business Center: a member with analytics-only permission on the account (role name to be checked in the interface). If it is not linked, there is no secondary access: a weekly export by the holder. Credentials are not shared.
steps: Check whether the BetRedge TikTok account is linked to a Business Center (business.tiktok.com).
If yes: Business Center → Users → Invite member → Steve's email → lowest role → assign the account with analytics-only permission (to be checked in the interface).
If no: every Monday the holder downloads the Analytics export of the last 7 days and passes it to Steve.
owner: Andrea (holder of the account: to be confirmed)
verify: Analytics → last 7 days → «Video views»: the same number for Steve and for the holder.

reads: Views, watch time, subscribers and traffic sources of the BetRedge channel.

steps: studio.youtube.com → Settings → Permissions.
Invite → Steve's Google email → Viewer role → Save.
If the Invite button is missing (channel managed another way), the path is to be checked in the interface.
owner: Andrea (holder of the channel: to be confirmed)
verify: Analytics → last 28 days → «Views»: the same number for Steve and for the holder.

steps: ads.x.com with the BetRedge account → account access settings (path to be checked in the interface).
Add Steve's personal handle → analytics-only role → Save.
If the option does not exist: every week the holder exports the Analytics data and passes it to Steve.
owner: Andrea (holder of the account: to be confirmed)
verify: Analytics → last 28 days → «Impressions»: the same number for Steve and for the holder.

reads: Comments posted, comments still live or removed, upvotes, replies, days of silence and clicks to the site.
role: No access. The u/Betredge credentials are not shared: the account is operated only by the reddit-betredge agent. Steve receives the metrics as a report.
steps: Steve asks marketing-betredge for the weekly report of the Reddit channel.
reddit-betredge compiles it from its daily round: comments sent, live or removed, upvotes, replies, days of silence.
The links in the comments must carry ?src=reddit, so the visits show up in «Sessions by source» (today almost all sessions have no source, G05).
verify: Dashboard → «Sessions by source» over 30 days: if the report declares clicks, there must be a src:reddit or referrer reddit.com row. If it is missing, the ?src= tag is not applied (G05).
